cohort: 100 pregnant patients presenting to a tertiary care setting in Lahore, Pakistan, divided into two groups of 50 obese and 50 non-obese individuals.
finding: Obese pregnant patients (BMI > 30 kg/m^2) had a higher incidence of LSCS (41.8%) compared to non-obese patients (BMI < 30 kg/m^2) with an LSCS rate of 21.8%.
